items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was playing with Miles’s band as a sideman.

ctx.x: That was the Five Spot, I’m sure.

It was probably the Five Spot. It's too bad it wasn’t documented by being recorded, because it was something to hear. That was one. On another occasion that I can recall – that stands out in my mind, and I like to look back on it and think about it – I was playing with Miles’s band as a sideman. We were in Chicago at a theater on the south
side of Chicago. The Regal Theater?
